<!-- Generated by PanWrite adapter compiler v5 from protocol/fleets/panwrite-plan-section.json; do not edit. -->

Create one contained, immutable plan for section {{section}} from the portable project state. Write only the plan artifact; the invoking action orchestrator owns validation, approval, section, checkpoint, and state reconciliation. The checker must independently review traceability, support for every required claim, author-decision fidelity, and feasibility without claiming a mutation.

On PanCode, write `project://sections/{{section}}/plans/<plan>` as `.planning/sections/{{section}}/plans/<plan>.md`, relative to the workspace root: section artifacts go under `.planning/sections/`, never a top-level `sections/`.
